lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Tuesday's Telluride Town Council meeting, where Council holds a public hearing on a vesting period extension for a development project and takes up the Flock Safety automated license plate reader system — two items that touch land use and civil liberties in ways worth paying attention to. Wednesday's budget work session lays the groundwork for the 2027 General and Capital funds, and the Comp Plan consulting team meets with P&Z on Thursday as that long-range planning process moves forward. On the community side, Pink Talking Fish plays the Sheridan Friday night, the annual San Miguel River Cleanup is Saturday, and ArtAbout runs the same day.
